title: The Why the Window Stays Open a Finger
youtube_title: The Why the Window Stays Open a Finger | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: Waiting your turn to talk lets someone feel heard.
summary: At a cottage hearth with the clock unhurried, Auntie June begins to tell Vera about why the window stays open one finger. Vera wants to interrupt with bigger news, but listens all the way to the last sentence, asks one real question, and only then shares something small of their own.
